coordinates: normalized presentation anchors (0..1); not production topology

desktop.labels: HTML labels below glyph; captions outside the scene

mobile.labels: Wrap at up to two lines; 14 CSS px minimum; if width insufficient use sequential pairs.

infraTopology.instruction: Retain the three named node silhouettes in stable slots; only the current owner/destination and blocking gate are foreground. Controller/storage stay in a labeled separate band in external-control. Never animate client requests through HA controller.

routePolicy: One traveling artifact per visible subbeat. Query requests travel requester→store; responses travel back separately. No arrow for mere grouping.
